details.description: Our new flavoured Makhana range offers a delicious, healthy, and guilt-free snacking option made from premium-quality lotus seeds. Lightly roasted and seasoned with exciting flavours, these makhanas are crunchy yet low in calories, making them the perfect choice for mindful snacking. Designed for today’s health-conscious consumers, the range combines taste, nutrition, and convenience, catering to the growing demand for better-for-you snacks. Available in six unique flavours - Chilli Tomato, Sour Cream & Onion, Pudina Punch, Cheese Melt, Salt & Pepper, and Peri Peri - it delivers something for every palate. Ideal for on-the-go snacking, 4 pm hunger pangs, evening cravings, or guilt-free indulgence, our flavoured makhanas bring a modern twist to traditional snacking. With flavours that linger and a crunch that stays, every bite is truly satisfying.
